categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Baoli International Investment Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: professional asphalt production and sales, and general aviation services including helicopter sales, leasing, and maintenance. The company also engages in financing leasing and BT (Build-Transfer) project investments. Asphalt products serve infrastructure projects such as highways, airports, and railways, while aviation services focus on emergency rescue, forest protection, and helicopter operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies in asphalt modification, including SBS, SBR, EVA, and PE modified asphalt, as well as polymer-modified emulsified asphalt. It invests in R&D for new materials like integrated thermoplastic elastomers from recycled rubber, silica composite modified asphalt, and high-modulus polymer-modified asphalt. Production methods emphasize quality control, environmental protection, and innovation, supported by collaborations with top Chinese universities and research institutes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large state-owned highway construction units, municipal road projects, and infrastructure developers. The aviation segment serves government agencies such as the National Emergency Management Department for aerial firefighting and rescue operations. The company’s asphalt products are used in national highways, provincial roads, urban roads, and overseas markets including Africa and Russia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production facilities in Jiangsu, Shaanxi, Hunan, Sichuan, Tibet, and Xinjiang provinces. It has expanded its market coverage nationwide and also actively develops overseas markets, notably in Russia and Africa. The aviation business includes subsidiaries in Singapore and Russia, with operations covering domestic and international regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Baoli International is positioned mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the asphalt supply chain, encompassing production, processing, storage, logistics, and sales. It also extends upstream through strategic cooperation with refineries to secure raw materials. In aviation, it operates in sales, leasing, maintenance, and supply of aviation materials, serving as a comprehensive service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on integrating the asphalt supply chain to provide one-stop services including procurement, warehousing, processing, logistics, and supply chain finance. R&D priorities include developing environmentally friendly and high-performance modified asphalt products, recycling waste rubber, and innovating in road maintenance materials. In aviation, the focus is on expanding helicopter sales, leasing, and after-sales services, leveraging partnerships with Russian and European manufacturers.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of asphalt materials and aviation equipment, leasing income from aircraft and aviation parts, and service fees from aviation operations such as emergency rescue flights. The company also earns income from BT project investments and financial leasing. Additionally, it engages in futures hedging and options trading to stabilize profits.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The asphalt industry in China is highly fragmented with many small-scale producers; Jiangsu Baoli International is among the leading companies in production capacity and supply chain integration but holds a relatively low market share compared to mature markets. The company differentiates itself through comprehensive supply chain services and technological innovation. In aviation, it is a leading authorized dealer of Russian helicopters in China, competing in the niche market of civil and emergency aviation services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues close to 2 billion RMB, with net profit attributable to shareholders of approximately 22.3 million RMB, marking a turnaround from previous losses. Total assets stood at about 1.7 billion RMB, and shareholders’ equity was around 964 million RMB. The company experienced a revenue decline of 8.23% year-over-year, mainly due to market conditions, but improved profitability and cash flow indicate a positive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Baoli International emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced asphalt products with strong brand recognition in East China. Its value proposition includes providing integrated supply chain solutions that enhance efficiency and reduce costs for customers. In aviation, the company offers comprehensive services including sales, leasing, maintenance, and parts supply, supported by exclusive partnerships with Russian helicopter manufacturers, ensuring reliability and tailored solutions for emergency and public service aviation needs.
